sources.title: Naga City Tourism: Plaza Quince Martires
sources.note: Supports the facts listed here; historical events do not date the current mapped geometry.

text.en: The monument honors fifteen Bicolano patriots who died during the Philippine Revolution.
Eleven of the martyrs were executed at Bagumbayan in Manila on January 4, 1897.
The memorial was erected on November 29, 1926.
Crispolo Zamora designed the monument, and José Barcena sculpted it.
